scope.interactionChannel: real macOS secondary click and menu selection via cliclick

observations.name: file row system menu
observations.detail: A real secondary click on README.md opens the macOS system menu with Copy mention and Add to chat.

observations.name: Add to chat
observations.detail: Selecting the highlighted Add to chat item writes [README.md](README.md) into the real Composer, focuses the editor, enables Send, and leaves the Lynxtron process alive.

rejectedSamples.detail: The first Add-to-chat implementation crossed a component-local main-thread closure and blanked the LynxView. It was replaced with the documented background-thread SelectorQuery setValue, setSelectionRange, and focus UI methods before the retained pass.
Several earlier clicks used incorrect Retina/window-shadow coordinate conversion and did not select a menu item. They receive no interaction credit.

closedProductLoss: Native file rows expose the Web authority's system menu actions.
Add to chat writes the canonical markdown mention into the real Composer without converting the textarea to a controlled input.
External insertion uses documented Lynx SelectorQuery UI methods and no longer blanks the LynxView.
remainingProductLoss: Question-mode Composer intentionally rejects file mention insertion, but Native has no toast surface explaining that rejection.
missingCoverage: Copy mention clipboard contents were not physically inspected.
Dark theme, nested directories, and narrow sheet layout are not retained.
classification.harnessLoss: Lynxtron 0.0.16 did not register an owned DevTool client, so no DevTool console or computed geometry is claimed.
classification.intentionalPlatformDelta: The popup uses native macOS menu material instead of Web popup pixels.

validation.productionBuild: pass with existing unsupported-CSS and Effect import.meta warnings
